verdict.rationale: Weave's own built-in and custom signals automatically classify agent interactions and surface failure modes inside the product. That is a thin form of automated insight from user data, and LLM-judge scorers add AI-generated assessments of outputs. The MCP server and coding-agent loops produce insights in external assistants, not inside the product, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that signals are AI/LLM-generated, in-product AI suggestions or recommendations, a natural-language insight or assistant feature inside the Weave UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
out-of-the-box signals to surface failure modes
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
Evaluate your agent’s or application’s responses using LLM judges and custom scorers
